description: An index's members on one date, point in time: the long stock positions of its tracking fund's newest SEC N-PORT portfolio FILED by that date (source.report_date is the portfolio's own quarter-end date, source.filed_on when it became public; a stock added to the index after report_date appears with the next filing). Each member has ticker (as of the date), name and weight_pct (percent of fund net assets). Ids from get_indexes. To screen members by fields, use get_universe or get_search with member_of instead. Costs 1 credit plus 1 per 100 members beyond 100.

date.description: Date YYYY-MM-DD (default today). History depth depends on plan.

name: get_index_members

data.description: The TickerDB API response payload for this tool call.
